title: CUJ-06: defect analysis gone from the working tree and both histories
description:
See .necklace/2026-08-26-public-release/cuj.md, CUJ-06.

Beads issue p11 analyses a defect in a named third party's project. It sits in 40 git commits from 7b0c5cc and 10 versions of dolt history. Full scrub chosen: the repo has never been cloned, so the rewrite is free once and never again.

RISK: git and dolt reference each other through refs/dolt/data. The two rewrites must be sequenced and verified together, not independently.

Tests (tests/r06-scrub.bats):
- the defect analysis is absent from the working tree
- the defect analysis is absent from every commit on every ref
- the defect analysis is absent from every version in the issue database
- beads still syncs after the rewrite
acceptance_criteria: tests/r06-scrub.bats green, each red when written
close_reason: p11 removed from the working tree, from 131 git commits, and from all 37 dolt history versions; refs/original cleared; 36 issues and 203 dolt commits intact, bd exports and agrees with disk. 4 tests green. NOT pushed.

description:

Possible signal: subject bbox aspect ratio, or bbox area far exceeding the filled pixel count.
